# Support

Need a hand? Here's where to go 👇

## Before you ask

Have a look at the [README](./README.md), and search [the directory](https://exitformat.peng.ly) itself. Then search [existing issues](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/exitformat/issues?q=is%3Aissue), because someone's likely hit the same thing.

---

## Where to ask

| I want to...                      | Go here                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ask a question or share an idea   | [Discussions](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/exitformat/discussions)                                 |
| Suggest a service                 | [Add a service](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/exitformat/issues/new?template=add-service.yml)       |
| Fix something on a service's page | [Fix an entry](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/exitformat/issues/new?template=fix-entry.yml)          |
| Report a bug                      | [Bug report](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/exitformat/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)           |
| Request a feature                 | [Feature request](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/exitformat/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Report a vulnerability            | [Security policy](./SECURITY.md) - **not** a public issue                                               |
| Contribute a change               | [Contributing guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md)                                                                 |

---

## Expectations

This is open source, maintained in spare time, so there's no guaranteed response time. Clear reports with a link to the page and the source for the fix are the ones that get sorted quickest.
